The annual scholarship programme for foreign citizens offered by Romania for the 2026-2027 academic year has now been launched!
The annual scholarship programme for foreign citizens offered by Romania, through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, based on Government Decision no. 288/1993 for the 2026-2027 academic year has now been launched!
Who can apply?
Foreign citizens from all non-EU countries,
with the following exceptions
:
citizens of Romanian origin or who are part of the Romanian historical communities in the proximity of Romania (entitled to different scholarship programmes);
citizens who have requested or acquired a form of protection in Romania;
stateless persons whose stay on the territory of Romania is officially recognized according to the law;
members of the diplomatic and consular corps or family members of the diplomatic and consular corps accredited to Romania;
members of the administrative and technical staff of diplomatic missions and consular offices accredited to Romania;
staff members of international organizations based in Romania or family members of staff of international organizations based in Romania;
beneficiaries of a scholarship from the Romanian state for the same cycle of study.
What level of study does the scholarship cover?
The scholarship applicant can choose from any of the following three study cycles in accredited higher education institutions in Romania:
bachelor’s degree
: addressed to graduates of high school studies or pre-university studies at the end of which they obtained a baccalaureate degree or equivalent, as well as candidates applying for further university studies in Romania. The complete programme runs for a period of 3-6 years, depending on the specialization followed and ends with a bachelor's exam;
master’s degree
: addressed to undergraduates, run for a period of 1 year, 1.5 years or 2 years and end with the dissertation exam;

master’s degree
: addressed to undergraduates, run for a period of 1 year, 1.5 years or 2 years and end with the dissertation exam;
PhD
: addressed to graduate students or equivalent, run for a period of 4 years. In order to be admitted to doctoral studies and to obtain the scholarship, it is compulsory that, prior to submitting the application, the candidate should get the written agreement of the Doctoral Tutor, which must be a member of the doctoral school, and also that he/she passes the admission interview.
Additional details:
Applicants may select their study program of interest in all fields,
with the exception of Medicine, Dental Medicine and Pharmacy
.
For Bachelor and Master, only study programs in Romanian are available,
thus promoting the Romanian language and culture. However, at PhD level, applicants can also opt for a program in English or a foreign language set by the doctoral school. For candidates who do not speak Romanian, a preparatory year (Romanian Language Preparatory Program) is granted for the study of the Romanian language prior to the actual university studies, except for doctoral scholarship holders who have opted for the form of education in a foreign language set by the doctoral school.
All study documents must be apostilled under the Hague Convention or authenticated
by the relevant authorities in the home country (e.g.: ministries of education).
All applicants are
required to hold a diploma or certificate confirming the completion of their studies and graduation exam
at the time of submission
.
All applicants
must possess a valid passpor
t to complete the application process.
Deadline
for submitting your application:
31 March 2026
Announcing
the selection results:
around 15 July 2026
***
Please note that applicants are strongly advised to carefully review the updated eligibility requirements before submitting their scholarship applications. In particular, special attention should be given to the new conditions concerning the apostilled / authentication of educational documents, as well as the mandatory submission of a valid passport as proof of identity. Applications that do not comply with these requirements may be deemed ineligible.
***Please check out regularly the section ”About the Programme” for an updated view on the programme’s terms and conditions.
The application process takes place exclusively online, via the dedicated
Scholarships
platform!
Apply now and come study in Romania! Good luck!
